summary.headline: Hephaestio Chapter Catalogue
summary.text: Continuation of the Venetian codex catalogue listing chapters of Hephaestio of Thebes, including astrological topics on lifespan, fortune, actions, children, friends and enemies, slaves, exile, death, time divisions, chronocratorship, marriage, illness, surgery, vomiting, and purgation. Cross-references identify Hephaestio II–III, Manetho, Ptolemy, and Florentine and Parisian codices.
